description: What each check, report type and signal does not detect (C279.1; ours, written in Workflow 11E by docs-catalog from each family page's limits as built). Keyed by registry id: CHECK_REGISTRY under checks, REPORT_REGISTRY under reports, SIGNAL_REGISTRY under signals. The check catalog (docs/checks/catalog.md) renders each entry in its last column; packages/docs-tools/src/catalog/ holds the test that every registry id has exactly one entry here.

checks.aamva_identification_number_comparison: No DLDV adapter ships; the sandbox provider answers deterministic test data. A jurisdiction outside DLDV is never judged (jurisdiction_not_participating), and a US card read only from its visual zone carries no IIN, so its issuer is unknown.
checks.aamva_identity_comparison: No DLDV adapter ships (it needs AAMVA membership); only the sandbox provider answers. Whether DLDV verifies the birth date in every jurisdiction is not confirmed, and a jurisdiction outside DLDV goes to review or is skipped, never passed.
checks.aamva_name_comparison: No DLDV adapter ships; the sandbox provider answers deterministic test data. A jurisdiction outside DLDV is never judged.
checks.business_website_backlink_detection: Disabled by default. A backlink count says nothing about who runs the site, and a count below the threshold is not evidence of fraud on its own.
checks.business_website_domain_age_detection: RDAP does not cover every TLD and never a subdomain on a platform: both answer domain_age_unavailable. An old domain can change hands, so age alone does not identify the business.
checks.business_website_malicious_website_detec: Disabled by default and needs a bound provider; without one it answers provider_not_configured. It sees only what the provider's feeds list.
checks.business_website_resolution_detection: Ours. It shows only that the domain resolves to a public address, not that the business operates the site.
checks.crypto_wallet_address_comparison: One ownership proof per chain family: no transaction-based proof, no proof of funds, no BIP-322 full or multisig scripts (signature_inconclusive). A counterfactual (ERC-6492) EVM wallet is inconclusive. Ownership is proven at signing time only; nothing watches the address afterwards.
checks.crypto_wallet_disallowed_chain_detection: Without allowed-chains every offered chain is allowed (no_allowlist, non-blocking). It judges the chain the user claimed, not where funds move.
checks.crypto_wallet_statement_comparison: It passes only for a signature the address check verified over exactly the challenge's bytes; it says nothing about later use of the key.
checks.crypto_wallet_validity_detection: It checks the address's format and checksum only. An all-lower-case or all-upper-case EVM address carries no checksum and passes unless require-evm-checksum is set; a valid address may still belong to someone else.
checks.database_address_comparison: No real database adapter ships; the sandbox provider is deterministic test data. Unit and floor words outside the normaliser's dictionaries are compared as text.
checks.database_birthdate_comparison: No real database adapter ships; the sandbox provider is deterministic test data. A transposed birth date answers birthdate_ambiguous rather than a mismatch.
checks.database_business_active_business_detect: GLEIF lists only businesses with an LEI, and EDGAR has no status, so many businesses go to review (status_not_available or no_registry_record), never to a failure. Source answer shapes for Companies House and EDGAR were not checked against the live services.
checks.database_business_associated_persons_com: Only the first 100 officers and persons with significant control of a Companies House record are read; a source that lists no persons answers source_has_no_persons.
checks.database_business_enabled_country_detect: Without the type's allowed-countries it answers no_allowlist and never blocks.
checks.database_business_identity_comparison: GLEIF misses most small businesses, and sole traders and partnerships are on no company register: both go to review, never to a failure. EDGAR is searched by name among listed companies only.
checks.database_business_service_available_dete: It reports only whether a bound register covering the country answered; outside every bound register's countries it answers provider_not_configured.
checks.database_identity_comparison: No real database adapter ships; the sandbox provider is deterministic test data. A non-authoritative miss is no_matching_record (review), not a failure, and non-Latin nicknames are absent from the nickname table.
checks.database_inquiry_comparison: It compares the entered values with the inquiry's own prefilled fields only; it says nothing about whether either is true.
checks.database_name_comparison: No real database adapter ships; the sandbox provider is deterministic test data. Non-Latin nicknames are absent from the nickname table.
checks.database_po_box_detection: It matches the shared mailbox patterns only; an address that is a mail drop under another form is not found.
checks.document_address_comparison: A party named only inside a clause of a prose contract is not read, so a lease's address may be the landlord's. It compares with the inquiry's fields, the newest passed or reviewed ID, or the account; with none it answers no_reference_data.
checks.document_expired_detection: Utility bills, bank statements, pay stubs and tax documents print no expiry (feature_absent). A date more than one day in the future is input_missing, never a pass.
checks.document_extracted_properties_detection: The name is read from an addressee block or a 'Label: value' field only; a party named in a clause of a prose contract is not read, and text drawn only as an image on a born-digital page is not read.
checks.document_fabrication_detection: A clean score proves nothing: a document generated from scratch carries none of the cues. A small copy-moved patch, text drawn only as an image and a JPEG 2000 scan inside a PDF are not measured, and annotations are counted on the analysed pages only (the first three and the last).
checks.document_name_comparison: A party named only inside a clause of a prose contract is not read. With no inquiry fields, ID extraction or account fields it answers no_reference_data.
checks.document_recency_detection: Recency is read from the printed date; the 18-month window for tax documents is ours and provisional, and a lease with an ended or unclear term answers input_missing.
checks.document_type_detection: Not a calibrated classifier: the type confidence is a probability of our own rules, not a measured accuracy. Uncovered languages that share function words with Spanish can be read as covered.
checks.email_address_disposable_detection: The pinned list is a snapshot; new throwaway domains appear daily. It sees only the operator's lists and the pinned list.
checks.email_address_mx_detection: It shows that the domain takes mail, not that the mailbox exists or belongs to the person.
checks.email_address_otp_comparison: No email link (code only). It proves access to the mailbox at the time of the code, not who owns it.
checks.id_aamva_database_lookup: No DLDV client ships; an adapter needs AAMVA membership, so outside the sandbox it answers provider_not_configured.
checks.id_account_comparison: Names are compared by Jaro-Winkler per token at name-threshold; it shows agreement with the account's stored fields, not that those fields are true.
checks.id_age_comparison: Without min-age or max-age it answers age_limits_not_configured. It reads the extracted birth date, so a forged date on a convincing card passes.
checks.id_age_inconsistency_detection: No permissively licensed age model exists, so only the port and the sandbox provider ship. Only the difference between the estimate and the birth date is kept.
checks.id_barcode_detection: Advisory by default. It reads a PDF417 where the established class carries one; it says nothing about the barcode's content matching the card.
checks.id_barcode_inconsistency_detection: Agreement needs two of the document number, birth date, expiry and surname read by both sources; with fewer, a sound payload answers input_missing. The IIN table holds the 72 published AAMVA IINs.
checks.id_blur_detection: Calibrated on synthetic cards only. A card on a background rectifies with a lower blur score than a tight crop, and a low-resolution card can look sharp: only the width catches it.
checks.id_color_inconsistency_detection: A colour cast on a region smaller than a sixteenth of the document is diluted, and a global cast (warm or cool light) is cancelled by design. Calibrated on synthetic cards only.
checks.id_compromised_detection: OCR reads horizontal print: a translucent stamp across the portrait or dense text is not read (the synthetic diagonal overprint passes). A listed number fails it only through a government ID number list marked for compromised IDs; an unreadable list answers compromised_list_unavailable.
checks.id_disallowed_country_detection: The sandbox test issuer has no country, and persons without a nationality (the ICAO X.. codes) have no ISO country.
checks.id_disallowed_type_detection: When the document class could not be established it answers input_missing rather than judging.
checks.id_double_side_detection: Without a feature row the back's feature is not judged. The back's MRZ is read by OCR.
checks.id_electronic_replica_detection: A recapture whose display grid is not resolved in the photo is not seen, and oblique periodic print such as a diagonal guilloche raises the moire score. Calibrated on synthetic cards only.
checks.id_entity_detection: A composite of the other heuristics and the hard signals: it sees nothing they do not, and its threshold is not calibrated (no synthetic variant scores above the genuine cards).
checks.id_expired_detection: It reads the extracted expiry date only; a convincingly altered date is not detected here.
checks.id_extracted_properties_detection: It shows that the fields were read, not that they are true; without OCR or a barcode it answers input_missing.
checks.id_extraction_inconsistency_detection: It needs two sources sharing at least two fields; otherwise input_missing.
checks.id_fabrication_detection: No synthetic variant is built to trip it (the genuine cards score at most 0.022), so its threshold is not calibrated.
checks.id_glare_detection: Glare is near-white, unsaturated pixels: a holographic overlay that saturates the sensor counts as glare. Calibrated on synthetic cards only.
checks.id_handwriting_detection: The calibration margin is small (the handwritten variant 0.462 against genuine cards at most 0.304), and large overprinted stamps and some screen recaptures also score as handwriting.
checks.id_inconsistent_repeat_detection: Only the five newest same-index extractions are compared, and no face embedding is stored for it.
checks.id_inquiry_comparison: Names are compared by Jaro-Winkler per token at name-threshold; it shows agreement with the inquiry's prefilled fields, not that they are true.
checks.id_mrz_detection: The OCR reads only [A-Z0-9<] in the zone; a letter read as a digit in a letter position is repaired and named by the C31.3 correction, nothing more.
checks.id_mrz_inconsistency_detection: Valid check digits alone do not show agreement with the card: it needs two of the document number, birth date, expiry and surname read by both the MRZ and the visual zone, otherwise input_missing. OCR correction changes at most one impossible character per field.
checks.id_nfc_chip_authentication_detection: A chip whose verified SOD lists no DG15 cannot be authenticated by the server (chip_auth_not_server_verifiable, non-blocking). EF.CardSecurity after PACE is not read (open, 11F's review).
checks.id_nfc_expired_detection: It reads DG1's expiry date; a current date is evidence only when the chip's integrity was established.
checks.id_nfc_mrz_comparison: OCR confusables are tolerated on every reading, since whether the printed check digits held is not recorded; a chip of another issuer finds no reference (no_reference_data), and issuer_mismatch is never answered.
checks.id_nfc_passive_authentication_detection: BSI defect lists and ICAO deviation lists are not read, so a document with a known issuer defect ends in review; a trust-store gap answers not_applicable, never a pass. The ISO/IEC 39794-5 DG2 path was not confirmed on a licensed sample.
checks.id_nfc_repeat_detection: Ours. A chip seen on another account goes to review by default (fail only with sighting-outcome: fail); a match without established integrity answers integrity_not_established.
checks.id_nfc_selfie_comparison: The 0.394 threshold was calibrated on studio portrait pairs, not on chip portraits, and is provisional here. Without a decided selfie it answers no_reference_data: chip data alone does not identify the presenter.
checks.id_number_format_inconsistency_detection: Without an established issuer, a number or a grammar that applies (a US territory or a Canadian card, for example) it answers input_missing.
checks.id_po_box_detection: It matches the mailbox patterns only (PO box, military and diplomatic mail, private mailboxes and international equivalents); other mail drops are not found.
checks.id_portrait_clarity_detection: No synthetic variant is built to trip it, so its thresholds are initial values, not calibrated ones.
checks.id_portrait_detection: The portrait is the largest face on the whole upload, so a person holding the card up to the camera may have their own face taken for the portrait.
checks.id_public_figure_detection: No gallery ships: it needs an operator-supplied gallery of stored embeddings; with an empty one it answers no_reference_data.
checks.id_real_id_detection: The star is a template match in the upper part of the card; no synthetic variant carries a star, so its threshold is not calibrated.
checks.id_repeat_detection: The pHash half ships disabled: no distance separated re-encodings of one card from distinct cards of the synthetic design. The number half needs an issuing-authority code and a number.
checks.id_selfie_comparison: In the default flow the ID comes before the selfie, so it answers input_missing there (advisory). The face-match threshold was calibrated on studio portrait pairs, not on selfies against ID card photos.
checks.id_tamper_detection: It does not detect the synthetic portrait swap or copy-move (inside the genuine range). Double compression is detected only for a re-save at a finer quality, and client uploads carry no camera EXIF because the clients re-encode them.
checks.id_unprocessable_submission_detection: A vertical card, or one turned more than 45 degrees, is not found as a document; min-text-lines does not separate the synthetic not-an-ID page, which is caught by document_not_found instead.
checks.id_valid_dates_detection: It checks that the dates are possible and in order (and a validity period within max-validity-years); a plausible forged date passes.
checks.phone_number_otp_comparison: No voice OTP. It proves access to the number at the time of the code, not who owns it; VoIP detection is only as good as libphonenumber's number-range metadata.
checks.selfie_account_comparison: The face-match threshold was calibrated on studio portrait pairs, not on selfies against ID card photos; without an earlier template or the matching consent it does not compare.
checks.selfie_age_comparison: No age model with permissive weights and training data exists: only the adapter part ships, so it needs a bound provider.
checks.selfie_face_covering_detection: A deep red covering can read as skin; beards, skin-toned masks and hands are unmeasured failure modes, and a mask over the nose can make the detector lose the face altogether.
checks.selfie_glare_detection: The eye regions are left out by design, so reflections on eyeglasses and catch-lights do not count; the threshold is provisional.
checks.selfie_glasses_detection: Rimless glasses with a thin bridge and no reflection are expected to be missed; the weights are provisional.
checks.selfie_id_comparison: Calibrated on studio portrait pairs only: a selfie against an ID card photo has lower genuine similarities and an unmeasured FRR, and per-group error rates are unmeasured (the set skews male and adult).
checks.selfie_image_quality_detection: A face the detector does not find at its 0.9 score threshold is face_not_present, whatever the cause; the thresholds are provisional.
checks.selfie_liveness_detection: Passive liveness scores digitally injected and synthetic frames as real, and is unvalidated on turned faces. At the default min-passive-score at least 5% of genuine studio portraits fail; the rate on genuine webcam selfies is unmeasured.
checks.selfie_multiple_faces_detection: It counts faces the detector finds above the area ratio; a second face on a side pose ends the inquiry as fraud on the first attempt.
checks.selfie_pose_detection: Five landmarks under-read real head turns, and the detector's frontal reading carries a per-face bias of about 0.03; head pitch is not judged.
checks.selfie_pose_repeat_detection: Planarity was exercised on synthetic re-poses and drawn artefacts only; the live class is unmeasured, so it stays advisory.
checks.selfie_public_figure_detection: No gallery ships: it needs a bound provider (provider_not_configured otherwise).
checks.selfie_repeat_detection: False matches grow with the gallery size (advisory by default); a truncated scan did not look at the oldest templates, and selfie galleries are expected to do worse than the studio portraits measured.
checks.selfie_similar_background_detection: Advisory only. Shared backdrops are common, virtual and blurred backgrounds defeat it, and the person mask is geometric, so long hair or raised hands leak into the background.
checks.selfie_suspicious_entity_detection: The detection rate is unmeasured and the heuristic does not detect modern generators; resizing and re-encoding weaken every cue.

reports.address-lookup: Normalised fields are never postal-corrected; deliverability and the provider's fields need a bound addressVerification provider (US only), and a CMRA hint is a keyword heuristic.
reports.adverse-media: Title mentions only: no title mention is not no coverage. The window is GDELT's rolling 90 days and the terms are in four languages; an article is a lead, and the name may be someone else's. Needs a bound adverseMedia provider.
reports.business-adverse-media: Title mentions only: no title mention is not no coverage. The window is GDELT's rolling 90 days and the terms are in four languages; needs a bound adverseMedia provider.
reports.business-watchlist: No ownership or 50%-rule screening: a company owned by a listed party is not found unless it is listed itself. Only the built-in sources are screened, and matching is evaluated on synthetic data only.
reports.crypto-address-watchlist: Exact match on canonical addresses only; a match says the address is listed, not who controls it now.
reports.custom-list: A match says normalised values are equal or near, nothing more. A list that could not be read is unscreened with its reason (never 'no match'), a fuzzy name list over the candidate cap is limit_exceeded, and an IP-derived country or point is approximate.
reports.email-address: Fields it could not decide are null with their reason, never false; breach exposure needs a bound provider, and several public fields are always null (no adapter or documented method).
reports.ip-address: Residential proxies, most VPNs, mobile carrier ranges and any address without an adapter's reputation; null means not in the lists held, never clean. The exit list has no IPv6 exits, and locations are approximate (IP geolocation by DB-IP).
reports.phone-number: No 0-1,000 risk score is synthesised; carrier, line type and SIM swap need a bound provider, and the numbering plan cannot see a number ported to a VoIP carrier.
reports.politically-exposed-person: A miss is not evidence that the person is not politically exposed: Wikidata's coverage is uneven by country and level, and dates are often missing.
reports.watchlist: No ownership or 50%-rule screening. Only OFAC, the EU, the UK and (opt-in) the UN lists are built in, and matching is evaluated on synthetic data only.

signals.inquiry/app_recognized: A sideloaded or self-built host app is unrecognized by design; UNEVALUATED is null, never false. Not decisive alone.
signals.inquiry/automation_artefact_count: The data is reported by the client; 0 carries no_artefact_found, not 'human'.
signals.inquiry/behavior_threat_level: Needs at least 3 screens and 20 input events, otherwise null (insufficient_behaviour).
signals.inquiry/bot_score: Real-device or OS-level automation, patched browsers and fraud-farm humans; a low score proves nothing.
signals.inquiry/country_comparison: Null for Tor, VPN-ASN, provider-range or privacy-relay sessions (ip_country_unreliable); an IP country is approximate (IP geolocation by DB-IP).
signals.inquiry/country_from_session: VPNs, roaming and corporate egress; an IP country is approximate (IP geolocation by DB-IP).
signals.inquiry/datacenter_detected: Anything outside the providers' published ranges; never false.
signals.inquiry/device_emulated: Emulators that hide their build properties; never false. Not decisive alone.
signals.inquiry/device_hooked: Renamed or late-injected hooking tools; never false. Not decisive alone.
signals.inquiry/device_integrity_level: The person; camera injection or a relay on a certified device; devices without Google Play. Not decisive alone.
signals.inquiry/device_rooted: Root hiding (Magisk's DenyList, Zygisk modules); never false or 'not rooted'. Not decisive alone.
signals.inquiry/handoff_count: It counts device handoffs only; it says nothing about who used each device.
signals.inquiry/list_match_count: It counts open list matches only; a list that could not be read is listed as unscreened, never counted as no match. Never a review rule.
signals.inquiry/max_session_distance: Needs DB-IP City Lite (off by default); a country is not a point, and a city point is a coarse estimate.
signals.inquiry/network_threat_level: Residential proxies and most VPNs; low means 'no listed risk found'.
signals.inquiry/proxy_detected: Anything without an ipReputation adapter bound.
signals.inquiry/session_count: A server-API inquiry has no flow sessions.
signals.inquiry/tor_detected: IPv6 (the exit list has no IPv6 exits); false only when every session was a public IPv4 address checked against a fresh list.
signals.inquiry/vpn_detected: Most VPNs (they rent general hosting); never false.
